video_timebase: simulation time, not real inference time

training.sampling: round-robin tasks, random frames without replacement within each task cycle
training.instructions: original plus two separate training paraphrases, cycling per task

hypotheses.H1: Equivalent paraphrases may change closed-loop success despite preserving task semantics.
hypotheses.H2: Original-instruction-only QLoRA may improve, preserve, or reduce paraphrase robustness; direction is not assumed.
hypotheses.H3: Offline imitation loss changes need not imply improved closed-loop success.

limits: One training seed, three related tasks and two hand-authored paraphrases: exploratory study, not a broad benchmark.
The official base checkpoint was already fine-tuned on LIBERO-Spatial; held-out local episodes are not claimed unseen to the base.
All failures and all 180 outcomes are retained; execution errors are not scored as task failures.
Instruction variants, task IDs and initial states are fixed before inspecting evaluation outcomes.
Same-initial-state outcomes are paired and not independent across paraphrases.
extension_disclosure: Designed after examining the original 180 rollouts. Same evaluation cases reused. No independent confirmatory generalization claim.
